Home Highlights:
- Gulf Views
- Private Resort-Style Pool and Spa (Pool can be heated for an additional $50 per day between Oct 1 - May 1)
- Complimentary beach setups include 2 chairs and 1 umbrella - Service provided Mar 1-Oct 31
- Elevator
- 6 Seater Golf Cart Included
- 6 Adult Bicycles Included
- New Construction
- Short Walk to the Beach

Discover the epitome of coastal luxury at Seven Palms Pinnacle, a magnificent new construction nestled in the prestigious Inlet Beach community. Boasting 8 bedrooms, 8 full bathrooms, and 1 half bathroom, this expansive retreat offers lavish accommodations for up to 28 guests, making it the ideal choice for unforgettable gatherings with family and friends.

As you step inside, you'll be greeted by a grandeur that transcends expectations. The centerpiece of this extraordinary home is its private resort-style pool, a tranquil oasis that beckons you to unwind and soak up the Florida sun. For added comfort, the pool can be heated for an additional fee, ensuring year-round enjoyment for all. The outdoor living space is designed for both relaxation and entertainment, featuring a mounted outdoor TV and Sonos audio system—perfect for enjoying your favorite shows, music, or game day gatherings poolside.

Spanning across 5,600 square feet and spread over three floors, Seven Palms Pinnacle exudes an aura of sophistication and relaxation. The sprawling balconies offer breathtaking Gulf views, providing the perfect backdrop for sipping morning coffee or watching the sunset with loved ones.

Inside, the meticulously designed living spaces are thoughtfully curated for both luxury and functionality. Multiple gathering areas offer ample room for socializing and entertaining, while the gourmet kitchen is a chef's delight, equipped with top-of-the-line appliances and elegant finishes. The home is outfitted with Sonos soundbars throughout the main living areas and outdoor spaces, allowing for seamless music enjoyment across the property. Additionally, YouTube TV with NFL Sunday Ticket is available throughout the home, ensuring you never miss a moment of the action.

Each of the 8 bedrooms is a sanctuary unto itself, featuring plush bedding, stylish decor, and private en-suite bathrooms for added convenience and privacy. With a total of 8 full bathrooms and 1 half bathroom, every guest can indulge in comfort and luxury.

Experience the pinnacle of coastal living at Seven Palms Pinnacle—an exquisite retreat where every detail is crafted to elevate your stay and create lasting memories.

THIRD FLOOR (Sleeps 12)
• Bedroom 6: Bunk Room (sleeps 8) Two Queen over Queen Bunks and Ensuite Bathroom with Single Vanity & Walk-in Tile/Glass Shower
• Bedroom 7: King Guest Suite (sleeps 2) King Bed and Ensuite Bathroom with Double Sink Vanity & Walk-in Tile/Glass Shower + Private Balcony
• Bedroom 8: King Guest Suite (sleeps 2) King Bed and Ensuite Bathroom with Single Vanity & Walk-in Tile/Glass Shower + Private Balcony

The house itself was stunning—spacious, spotless, and so beautifully designed. The location was GREAT, close to everything we needed yet private enough to relax and enjoy.Our host was truly amazing—friendly, helpful, and went above and beyond to make sure our trip was seamless. Communication was 100/10, quick and easy from start to finish. Every detail made us feel so welcome and cared for.We made the best memories here and had such a fun, special weekend. None of us wanted to leave! We will definitely be coming back and recommending this house to everyone we know.

reviews.text: The seven palms house is located in inlet beach Florida. The location is perfect. It is within closing driving distance to shoppes, restaurants, the grocery store and other popular beach areas like PCB, Destin, Rosemary beach, seaside shoppes, and A30. The actual house itself is perfect! Extremely clean and the amenities such as the pool, golf cart, and bikes are a major plus. My family and I had an amazing time staying at 7 palms and we will most definitely be back next year!!! I highly recommend this home for families or large groups! Well worth the money! I have absolutely no complaints!
